extra.title: shaadqrsh.com
extra.about: My portfolio site, with a page for each project and a resume PDF generated from the same data file.

countingsheep.about: Solo 3D platformer made in 96 hours for GMTK Game Jam 2026. You hop across cloud platforms shaped like the number being counted down, and they fall apart under you. Rated 4.5/5 in every category except audio.

harvestrush.about: One or two player farming game in the spirit of Overcooked. Fill the delivery truck's order before it leaves while pests (A* pathfinding) and spreading fires get in the way.

bushido.about: Samurai-themed fangame, 10 to 15 hours long, made by a team of 4 in 30 days. Won 1st of 31 at Relic Castle Winter Jam #2. I did the core engine work and new mechanics like Katana techniques and following Pokémon.

splice.about: Fangame with a form-changing starter and a branching story that changes depending on which team you side with. Won 1st of 46 at Relic Castle Game Jam 6. Team of 4, 30 days.

sqllift.about: Full-stack workout tracker for a database course: plan workouts, log sets live, track progress, and compete on leaderboards. I wrote Flask API modules and set up the CI/CD pipeline.

nanorewind.about: Web app that restores scratched and faded family photos with Google Gemini. You pick a photographic style like Cyanotype or Kodachrome 64, then compare the result with the original using a loupe, a slider, or side by side. Supabase handles accounts, credits, and a private photo album.

careerpath.about: AI career counselor that builds personalized roadmaps and "day in the life" previews. Built in 3 days.

homi.name: HOMI
homi.about: Learning assistant for IT students: study material, answers to questions, generated practice tests, and attendance and assignment tracking.

findly.name: Findly
findly.about: Android lost-and-found app with a live item feed and in-app chat.

emaadportfolio.about: Portfolio site for Emaad, an artist in my family. They add and edit pieces through a Decap CMS dashboard without touching code.

tictacgone.about: 3D tic-tac-toe for the browser where each player can only keep three pieces on the board. Placing a fourth removes your oldest, so a game never ends in a draw. Play a friend on the same device or the computer on three difficulty levels. The models and audio are all generated in code, with no asset files.

Roblox Racing Challenge.line: 1st place, Grand Prize. Wrote a Lua vehicle controller in Roblox Studio within a one-hour limit, then tuned it until it won the head-to-head race.

GMTK Game Jam 2026.name: GMTK Game Jam
GMTK Game Jam 2026.line: Counting Sheep, made solo in 96 hours.

IIT Madras Shaastra Techathon.line: Led a team of 4. Placed 2nd in my college and 116th in India.
